question: Which office of the government of India is the governing department of nuclear energy?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Office of the Prime Minister**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The governing department of nuclear energy in India is the **Department of Atomic Energy (DAE)**, which functions directly under the **Office of the Prime Minister**.
 
• The DAE is responsible for the development of nuclear energy for peaceful purposes, including power generation and research.
 
• Established in 1954, the DAE manages the development, research, and application of nuclear technology, focusing on energy generation, healthcare, agriculture, and industry.
 
• Key responsibilities of the DAE include:
 
 
• Development of nuclear power plants for generating electricity.
 
• Research and development of nuclear technologies, including in medicine (radiation therapy), agriculture (improving crop varieties), and industry.
 
• Ensuring the safety, regulation, and proper use of nuclear resources in line with international standards and agreements.
 
• Operating nuclear research institutions such as the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) and the Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Ministry of Power**:

 
 
• The Ministry of Power is responsible for overseeing the development and regulation of India's power sector
 
• It formulates policies for power generation, transmission, and distribution, and works to ensure affordable and reliable electricity across the country.
 
 
• The ministry also promotes renewable energy sources and energy efficiency initiatives.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Office of the Home Minister**:
 
 
• This office oversees internal security, law and order, and domestic policy matters.
 
• It manages national security agencies, border management, and disaster response.
 
• The Home Ministry also handles issues related to citizenship, immigration, and criminal justice in India.
 
 
 
• **Office of the Defence Minister**:
 
 
• The Office of the Defence Minister is responsible for the defence and security of India.
 
• It oversees the Indian Armed Forces (Army, Navy, and Air Force) and handles defense procurement, military policy, and national defence strategies.
 
• The office ensures the country's defense preparedness and manages relations with other nations on defense matters.
